quote_text:
You have to be patient, the players were patient,  but that one moment of quality came in the end.
Yeah, it was a super goal and just  the idea to find a way to take a  
shot in this situation and the quality. He has this moment — he has done some  
similar goals this season before — so he's  a real asset for us in these moments when  
the games are so tight and you need  your goal scorers in these moments.
The team seemed pretty calm. I think there was  maybe a little bit of increasing nervousness and  
tension from the stands towards the end, but that  kind of calmness, that stability that you've been  
looking for all season was definitely  there for the 80 minutes before that.
Yeah, I think like the Rangers game at  home was a game for a lot of pressure,  
and we learned a lot from this game. And then we have the semi-final against Hearts,  
and the trust the players shown each other  and trying to be consistent into the games  
and try to trust the way we play and each other. And I think they act really well also against  
Hearts, and today again because  Hibs are good — is a good team. 
They are really fast in transitions,  when they pick up the second balls,  
how we attack the problems after that. So we have to be concentrated the whole game.
So that’s concentration and the matureness. 
When we have 1-0 today, how we manage the  game the last minutes was really nice to see. 
And also the squad — so many players  are back and available and they bring  
other qualities to the team when we need it. And everybody’s focus on the right things.
You've got another massive game next weekend. Does a little bit of pressure off in some ways  
because you know you got the victory today? You're not desperate for the victory but  
it's going to be a really, really tough  one going down the road next weekend.
Yeah, it is. But I think  
the pressure has been on us in the last — I  don't know — 12 games or something like that. 
Because we were in a challenging time, and then  we know to arrive to Europe we have to win a  
lot of games left of the season. So it's no difference for us. 
We have been under this pressure for a while now. 
But we focus on our performance, and the things  we can focus on is our games, the way we play,  
and try to win our games and leave the rest. And we had to focus on our things really good.
Obviously two very big moments late in the  game last week and late in the game today. 
How big a boost can that give the  team going into these last four games?
No, I think like we're building a trust among  each other, and everybody is ready to perform. 
And I think again use the squad,  and the players come in today. 
Because I think we start the game really well,  
how we play today and attack them,  try to get behind them in a good way. 
And then the second half they start  better and then the momentum change again.
And I think that's the part of our  journey we do together with the squad. 
And how they have been stable. Even I think late goals — you  
know like we have quite a lot of games this  year winning late — and that's a stability,  
how we perform and trust each other. And then finally we don't change too much,  
trying to be stable there but still have  an extra push when we change the players.
Stadium was buoyant again. 
Did that feel a little bit like  the start of the season again?
No, I think they have been like this  the whole season for us, away and home. 
But it's only winning 1-0 or a tight game,  the emotions are so high and the fans,  
everybody’s singing and the players act and come  into the game and raise everything, the emotions. 
So I think our fans, supporters the  whole season, has pushed us through this. 
And it's going to lead them to the last  game of the season, every from now on.
You ask me this question sometimes  now — and he's still not our player. 
We happy when he's here. And he look happy. 
But I can't talk about other teams’ player. 
But right now he's here, and we  are so happy that he's here today.
And I think that's what I was saying, like it's  the way we defend the game inside the game today. 
Like they are strong in some  moments, Hibs, like we see. 
Of course we learned from  last played them last time. 
But if you miss one time, they are dangerous.
So the stability and the patience we use today  and the cooperation among the players have  
control of the situations. And Matt of course is a  
strong player and smart in his duels. But also how they cover each other and helping  
each other with the second balls and the running. So I'm so proud how the team can stay in a  
game when they have the strong moments  and give us a chance to win the game.
So it's much more mature in some  areas right now where we are. 
But next week is another game  again, and it's different opponent. 
So we have to try to focus  on our performance and stay  
on that level because we're going  to need it the rest of the season.
Was that a difficult decision at all to  put Jamie on given his signing perhaps?
No, I told you before the game also in the  press, like Jamie is fully committed here. 
And you can see it if you know him as a person. And also how he acts in the training sessions,  
in the meetings, and performance  against Hearts and performance today. 
So it's no doubt where his mind is right now.
Thank you.
title: Jimmy Thelin FULL Post Match Press Conference | Aberdeen 1-0 Hibs
